Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

The sales team at Justworks is ultimately in charge of expanding our customer base while driving revenue and growth. As an Account Executive in-territory in Chicago, you will be responsible for the full sales cycle - building and managing a sales pipeline, market research, prospecting, fostering relationships and creating new ones, contract negotiation, and closing on your deals. Sales is challenging, especially at a start-up but it’s a fulfilling and rewarding experience as you become a trusted advisor to our customers.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

• Manage own book of business, build and manage an end-to-end sales pipeline and all supporting activities; prospect to close; meet or exceed your quotas

• Establish a presence in the Chicago territory; research the ins and outs of your territory, develop a marketing and networking plan for how you will reach entrepreneur community in your market , and build relationships with the small business community

• Proactively prospect for new business by leveraging market research, sales tools, and cold prospecting

• Gain a sound understanding of our value proposition and effectively communicate that to new potential customers

• Be the voice of our future customers - suggest innovative ideas to generate sales, cultivate customer pipeline leads; improve overall customer experience  and advocate internally for product development

• Be an ambassador of Justworks and its solutions; strive to gain an intimate and comprehensive knowledge of our suite of products

• Travel in- territory in the Chicago and Greater Chicago area

• Perform other duties as needed based on department and/or organizational needs

How You Will Do Your Work

As an Account Executive, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

• Good judgement - the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.

• Detail-oriented - exercises extreme attention to detail; is thorough, accurate, organized, and productive and seeks to understand both the cause and effect of a situation.

• Foundational sales knowledge - the specific set of sales skills (prospecting, cold calling, nurturing, engaging, presenting, negotiating, closing etc) and knowledge (product, markets, trends, business etc) a salesperson possesses to enact the exchange of value between a buyer and the vendor.

• Results-driven - consistently achieves results, even under difficult circumstances.

• Clear communication - the ability to articulate thoughts and express ideas effectively using oral, written, visual and non-verbal communication skills, as well as listening skills to gain understanding.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

• Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

• Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

• Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

• Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

• Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

• A minimum of 2 years experience in an Account Exec

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business.

Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions.

The police are one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. Police officers spend a large proportion of their time on data work and comparatively little on the actual investigation. We want to turn that around. With our new police solution, Metropolis, we help police authorities connect and make sense of their data, so that officers can focus on what matters most: solving cases and keeping people safe .

To address this, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Police .

The Role:

This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows police work from the inside: how investigations really run, where time is lost in data work, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships with police authorities at federal and state level and position Celonis as a long-term partner for their digital transformation.

Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of police work into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market.

• Bring the voice of the police into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering.

• Represent Celonis at public sector events, conferences and police-specific forums.

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. •
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•

•
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.

Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.

You know how to build relationships that matter and understand the US enterprise tech landscape. You enjoy creating spaces where senior leaders actually want to connect and learn. If you’re ready to shape how a major developer brand grows its B2B footprint from the ground up, keep reading.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

The US is our largest market, and we already have a strong customer base here. Now, we need to build a more focused, relationship-driven field marketing presence to drive our next phase of B2B growth. You’ll take the lead on shaping this approach from the ground up. Working closely with our US Sales and global marketing teams, you’ll design programs that engage enterprise decision-makers and strengthen strategic customer relationships. You’ll have the autonomy to prioritize target accounts and geographic markets, activating agencies and partners to scale your execution across the country.

Day to day, you will:

• Partner with Sales to map out target accounts, industries, and regional priorities, turning global strategies into focused US programs.

• Design and run executive roundtables, customer events, and industry programs that bring senior technology leaders together.

• Select and manage a network of agencies, event organizers, and partners to help execute your strategy across the US.

• Collaborate with global account-based marketing (ABM) teams to generate qualified leads and build meaningful business opportunities.

• Translate our broader narrative around agentic software development into relevant field initiatives that resonate with enterprise tech leaders.

What you’ll bring

• An entrepreneurial mindset. You are comfortable building programs from scratch and navigating ambiguity.

• A hands-on approach to your work. You take ownership of the strategy while also handling the details.

• Exceptional communication skills. You engage confidently with senior executives and stakeholders.

• A collaborative spirit. You build strong working relationships with global, cross-functional teams across different time zones.

• Deep industry insight. You understand exactly how software engineering organizations evaluate and adopt new technologies.

What you’ll need

• Proven success in US B2B field marketing, ideally within enterprise software or SaaS.

• A track record of attracting senior technology decision-makers to targeted events and account programs.

• Experience coordinating multiple external partners and agencies while maintaining strategic control.

• Practical experience running account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives in close collaboration with sales teams.

• Location in the United States and the ability to travel domestically as needed.

What success looks like

In your first few months, you’ll establish strong alignment with US Sales and global marketing, identifying key regional priorities. Long-term, you’ll build a predictable, high-impact field marketing engine that deepens our relationships with enterprise decision-makers, generates qualified business opportunities, and establishes JetBrains as a trusted partner for AI-driven software development in the US.

Why join JetBrains?

• Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.

• Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.

• Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.

• Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.

• Internal events. Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We’re hiring a Clinical Navigator (Medical Assistant) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm in your local time zone.

What You’ll Do

• Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.

• Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.

• Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.

• Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.

• Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.

• Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

• A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.

• Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.

• Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.

• Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.

• Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.

• Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

What You Need

• An active Medical Assistant certification from an accredited association (either AAMA, AMCA, AMT, NHA, NAHP, NCCT, NRCMA/NRCAMA, or AAH) is required.

• At least 5 years of experience as a Medical Assistant is required.

• Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.

Job Title: Senior GTM Engineer

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
At Salesloft, our Senior GTM Engineer is pivotal to turning signals into pipelines. You will be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering, with real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline.

We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, and now we need someone who builds. You will own the systems that connect our data (Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks) to action (Salesloft Rhythm, Marketo, LeanData), turn buying signals into plays reps actually run, and put AI agents to work on the busywork that slows marketing, sales, and CS down.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for building and running the GTM systems that drive the pipeline. Specifically, you will:

• Build and maintain integrations and workflows across Salesforce, Salesloft, Clari, Marketo, LeanData, ZoomInfo, 6sense, 1mind, and Tines.

• Write SQL and Python against Snowflake and Databricks to build signal logic, scoring, and data products.

• Turn usage, intent, job change, pipeline-trigger, and deal-health signals into Rhythm plays, and measure what they produce.

• Build and run AI agents and automations with logging, guardrails, and a named owner for each one.

• Keep data clean through deduplication, enrichment waterfalls, field governance, and routing hygiene.

• Partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.

• Document everything, so that if you’re out for two weeks, the system keeps running.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE (our values, in this role)

• Move as One: You’ll partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.

• Evidence over Ego: You’ll measure what your plays produce and retire the signals that don’t perform.

• Lead from the Front: You’ll own the systems you build from launch through monitoring, with a named owner for each one, and document them so they keep running when you’re out.

• Make Your Mark: As the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the team, you’ll shape how we turn signals into pipelines and help hire the next GTM Engineer.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a bias-towards-action, results-oriented builder who ships production systems, explains them to a sales leader in plain English, and stays laser-focused on the pipeline. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING

• 5+ years building in GTM systems (RevOps, marketing ops, sales ops, or GTM engineering), with production builds you can walk us through.

• Strong SQL and working Python or JavaScript, and comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, plus at least two of: Marketo, LeanData, Salesloft or Outreach, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Snowflake.

• Experience with a workflow or iPaaS tool such as Tines, Tray, Workato, or n8n.

• You’ve shipped something with LLMs or agents that real people rely on every day.

• You can explain a build to a sales leader in plain English and tie it to the pipeline.

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

• Experience with dbt, reverse ETL (Census, Hightouch), or Databricks.

• Experience with Clay or ZoomInfo GTM Studio.

• You’ve been through a merger or a CRM migration.

• A background in marketing ops or RevOps before moving into engineering.

THE TEAM
You’ll be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering. We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, so you’ll have real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline. • Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (Python preferred) for data analysis and automation

• Clear communication skills, and the ability to influence engineering and finance stakeholders without direct authority

• Financial and engineering fluency - able to translate technical architecture decisions into financial impact, and financial goals into technical action.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We’re hiring a Clinical Navigator (Licensed Practical Nurse) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM in the Pacific time zone.

What You’ll Do

• Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.

• Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.

• Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.

• Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.

• Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.

• Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

• A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.

• Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.

• Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.

• Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.

• Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.

• Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

What You Need

• An active compact multi-state LPN/LVN license in the state where you currently reside is required.

• At least 5 years of clinical experience as a Licensed Practical Nurse is required.

• Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.

• An active CA state LVN license is required

• Fluency in Spanish is preferred.

• Experience providing patient ed

Salary : $2,000 - $3,000 AUD
Working Hours & Conditions : 8 Hours per day 5 days per week
Holidays : Applicants local holidays apply

ABOUT THE COMPANY:
The company is a Melbourne-based landscape design studio founded by Drew Burns, specialising in native and climate-adaptive gardens for residential clients across Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula. The client's philosophy is simple: every project starts with a clear plan that resolves layout, levels, materials, and planting before anything is built - so construction happens without guesswork, miscommunication, or costly rework.
The studio's process runs in two stages: a concept report developed locally with the client, followed by detailed construction drawings. We're growing our team to bring the construction drawing stage in-house on an offshore basis, freeing up our local design team to focus on new client work while drawings progress in the background.

ROLE OVERVIEW:
We're looking for a skilled CAD draftsperson to take finalised landscape design concepts and turn them into accurate, buildable construction drawing sets. This is a genuine long-term team role, not a one-off gig - we're investing in someone who wants to grow with the business, not just complete tasks.
The ideal candidate is confident in producing both construction drawings and photorealistic renders, giving us a single point of contact who can carry a project from concept through to construction-ready documentation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Convert approved concept designs into detailed, accurate construction drawing sets (setout plans, levels, sections, details, planting plans, and material schedules).

• Work primarily in Vectorworks to ensure drawings are consistent with the client's existing file standards and templates.

• Produce photorealistic or presentation-quality renders to support client approvals, where required.

• Liaise with Drew and the local design team to clarify design intent, resolve details, and incorporate feedback.

• Maintain drawing accuracy for levels, drainage falls, and material junctions so drawings are genuinely buildable on site.

• Manage your own workflow and deadlines across multiple concurrent projects, flagging risks or delays early.

• Keep drawing files, layers, and naming conventions organised and consistent across projects.

• Proven, verifiable proficiency in Vectorworks is strongly preferred.

• Candidates with strong experience in SketchUp, Revit, or AutoCAD will also be considered - we're open to supporting a transition to Vectorworks.

• Background in landscape architecture, landscape design, or architectural drafting, ideally with residential project experience.

• Understanding of construction documentation: setout, levels, sections, details, and materials - not just drafting for visual presentation.

• Rendering skills (e.g, Enscape, D5) are a strong advantage.

• Strong written English for clear communication with the Australian-based team.

• Reliable internet connection and the ability to work overlapping hours with an Australian (Melbourne, AEST/AEDT) team.

What We're Looking For
Technical skill matters, but it's not the only thing we're hiring for. We value:

• Genuine attention to detail - drawings that are accurate the first time, not just "close enough."

• Strong work ethic and reliability - someone who owns their workload and communicates proactively.

• A long-term mindset - we're looking to invest in this role and grow it over time, not treat it as disposable outsourced labour.

• Honesty about your actual skill level and software experience - we'd rather know upfront than discover gaps later.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-draftsperson-construction-drawings-specialist

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on

• Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.

• Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.

• Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.

• Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

• Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.

• Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.

• Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.

• Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Overview

The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, Targeting and advertiser-facing recommendations - converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while carefully balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.

In this role, you will apply your expertise in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field to help build and refine the algorithmic systems that power how Instacart's advertising marketplace operates. Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.

Every signed customer agreement at Elation passes through a final review before billing and onboarding begin. That review confirms what the customer signed matches what we set up in Salesforce: the right products, quantities, prices, and dates. When it's done well, customers get billed correctly from day one and our finance and customer success teams avoid costly cleanup later.We are looking for a Contract Operations Associate to join our Business Systems Team on a contract basis and own a share of these reviews. You'll work from clear checklists and procedures, use AI-assisted review tools, and partner closely with the specialists who own this process. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who is detail oriented, enjoys getting things exactly right, and wants hands-on exposure to how a SaaS company runs its revenue operations.

What You'll Do

Contract Review & Verification

• Own a daily review queue of signed deals awaiting final approval, starting with new customer agreements, downgrades, and simple add-ons (adding a product or seats), then expanding to renewals and other deal types as you ramp.

• Confirm the signed order form is complete : both the customer and Elation have signed and dated it, and you identify the official execution date.

• Check that key dates line up across the order form, the Salesforce opportunity, and the quote (execution date, close date, and contract start date), and that add-ons end on the same date as the customer's existing contract.

• Reconcile the quote against the order form line by line: products, quantities, terms, unit prices, and totals, including confirming that unchanged products and removed products are recorded correctly.

• Verify approvals and required data : discounts have a documented approval, required fields are filled in, and the customer account is a real, active practice rather than a trial.

• Correct routine issues directly in Salesforce (e.g., date fields or account details) when the procedure allows it, then advance the deal to Closed Won.

• Confirm downstream handoffs fired after approval, such as the customer's billing record and onboarding project being created, and flag anything that didn't.

Partnering with Sales & Customer Success on Corrections

• Return deals that need fixing to the account executive or customer success manager who owns them, with a clear, specific note: what doesn't match, where you found it (order form page, quote line, field), and what correct looks like.

• Follow corrections through to completion : track returned deals, check that the fix is right when they come back, and re-review promptly so customers aren't left waiting on billing or onboarding.

• Prioritize with deal owners during busy periods like month end, communicating which deals are blocked and what's needed to close them on time.

• Spot repeat issues by rep, team, or deal type and share them with the team, so we can improve training, Salesforce guardrails, and error messages and prevent the same mistake next time.

Resolving Open Questions with Stakeholders

• Bring questions to the right person with full context : the deal link, what you checked, what's unclear, and your best guess at the answer. Start with the team's operations specialist, then partner with Deal Desk, Customer Success leadership, Finance (billing and revenue reporting), or Salesforce administrators as directed.

• Escalate anything outside the checklist rather than making judgment calls on your own, such as contract exceptions, non-standard discounts, unusual date requests, or large and custom agreements.

• Track every open question until it's resolved , keeping the deal owner updated so nothing stalls silently in the queue.

• Capture the answer once a question is settled, adding it to the procedure or FAQ so the next reviewer doesn't have to ask again.

Tools, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Run AI-assisted review tools first on each deal, then complete the manual checklist and confirm or correct the tool's results; your corrections help improve the automation.

• Log issues and root causes in our ticketing system for any deal that didn't pass cleanly.

• Flag gaps or confusing steps in our procedures; your feedback directly shapes the documentation and training for future reviewers.

What You Bring

• Attention to detail : you notice when two documents don't match, and you double-check before calling something done.

• Process discipline : comfortable following a checklist exactly, every time, and keeping clean records of your work.

Senior Customer Success Manager

About the Role

Freestar's publishers need partners who can grow with them — and the Senior CSM role exists for someone who brings that depth. You own a portfolio of Freestar's more complex, higher-stakes publisher relationships, operating with a level of autonomy and strategic influence that goes beyond day-to-day account management.

You've been in this industry long enough to have developed real pattern recognition. You know what good monetization looks like across different publisher types, you can spot a floor pricing problem before it shows up in the numbers, and you've had enough difficult client conversations to navigate them without breaking a sweat. You don't need a playbook for every situation — and when one is missing, you help build it.

This role sits at the intersection of trusted advisor and yield expert. Your publishers should feel like they have a genuine advocate inside Freestar, and your peers should feel like they have a resource they can learn from.

What You'll Do

Publisher Partnership

• Own a portfolio of Freestar's more complex publisher accounts, serving as their primary strategic point of contact

• Lead executive business reviews with a clear point of view — not just a performance recap, but a forward-looking perspective on where the relationship should go

• Build deep, multi-threaded relationships within publisher organizations, spanning revenue, ad ops, product, and editorial

• Anticipate risks and opportunities before they're surfaced by the publisher, and come to every conversation prepared with a recommendation

Yield & Optimization

• Take ownership of performance analysis end-to-end — identifying trends, forming hypotheses, designing tests, and tracking outcomes across your portfolio

• Drive more sophisticated optimization work: auction dynamics, floor pricing strategy, identity and audience approaches, format diversification, and the interplay between user experience and revenue

• Serve as a technical resource for both your publishers and your peers — able to go deep on programmatic mechanics and explain them clearly to any audience

• Collaborate with yield, demand, and product teams on bespoke solutions for accounts with unique needs or meaningful scale

Strategic Growth

• Identify and develop expansion opportunities that are genuinely additive — new products, formats, or services that make sense for each publisher's specific situation

• Contribute meaningfully to renewal conversations, bringing a clear account narrative and commercial instincts to the table

• Flag patterns you're seeing across your portfolio that could inform product development, demand strategy, or CS process improvements

Team Contribution

• Mentor and support junior CSMs, sharing your experience and helping elevate the team's collective standard

• Help build and refine playbooks, QBR templates, and best practices based on what you're learning in your accounts

• Contribute to onboarding and training as a subject matter resource

What We're Looking For

• 5–8 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a publisher-facing role within ad tech or programmatic advertising

• Proven track record managing complex, high-value accounts with multiple stakeholders

• Deep, working knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem — header bidding, floor pricing, auction mechanics, yield optimization, GAM, and identity solutions

• Strong analytical instincts: you're comfortable owning performance analysis independently and turning data into a clear narrative

• Executive presence and communication skills — able to hold a room at the VP or C-suite level without leaning on a script

• A coaching mindset — you share what you know and make the people around you better

• Self-directed and proactive; you manage a complex book without needing to be prompted

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Indonesia

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/3k8LqqAdNwD4WEpupmsk52/jobs-at-mash

Location: Malaysia preferred
Format: 12-month fixed-term contract
Market: Japan
Experience: 1–3 years
Language: Fluent Japanese and professional English

We’re looking for a driven Japanese-speaking Sales Development Representative to support the growth of a publisher acquisition programme across Japan.

This role focuses on identifying and qualifying prospective partners, building relationships within the local app developer, gaming and web publisher community, and creating opportunities for the wider sales team.

You’ll combine research, outreach and relationship-building with a strong understanding of the local market. You’ll be comfortable starting conversations, learning how digital businesses generate revenue, and helping prospective partners understand the value of digital advertising and monetisation solutions.

This is a great opportunity for someone with 1–3 years of early-career sales or business development experience who wants to build their career within technology, apps, gaming and digital advertising.

Lead Generation & Qualification

• Research prospective app developers, gaming studios, web publishers and digital businesses across Japan using Salesforce, Google Play Store, App Store, market intelligence platforms, industry events and networking.

• Qualify leads using agreed criteria and relevant business and app metrics, including downloads, active users, revenue and growth potential.

• Build and maintain an organised pipeline of prospects, keeping lead status and activity accurate in Salesforce.

• Stay close to local market developments and identify emerging businesses, trends and opportunities worth pursuing.

Outreach & Relationship Building

• Execute targeted outreach through email, phone, social media, events and community engagement.

• Build relationships with prospective publishers and developers and understand their business, growth priorities and monetisation needs.

• Communicate relevant programme and product value propositions clearly and confidently.

• Support publishers in understanding digital advertising and monetisation solutions and connect them with the right internal expertise where required.

• Build credibility within Japan's app developer, gaming and publisher communities through thoughtful and culturally appropriate engagement.

Sales & Market Support

• Schedule and coordinate qualified meetings between prospective partners and the wider sales team.

• Support preparation for prospect meetings and presentations by gathering relevant company, market and performance information.

• Track outreach activity, meetings, pipeline progress and conversion in Salesforce.

• Share recurring prospect feedback, local-market insights and emerging opportunities with regional stakeholders.

• Support relevant industry events, networking opportunities and partner engagement initiatives.

About You

• Ideally 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, sales development, business development, partnerships or another client-facing commercial role.

• Fluent Japanese with strong written and verbal communication skills, alongside professional working English.

• Strong understanding of Japanese business culture and the confidence to engage professionally with local stakeholders.

• Curious about technology, apps, gaming, digital advertising and the wider publisher ecosystem.

• Strong research skills with the ability to identify promising businesses and assess commercial opportunities.

• Confident starting conversations with prospective clients and developing relationships over time.

• Comfortable working with data and using simple insights to support outreach and commercial conversations.

• Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple prospects, follow-ups and priorities.

• Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn.

• Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is useful.

• Previous experience within technology, apps, gaming, AdTech, media or digital businesses is valuable but not essential.

Please note
Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to every one of you, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mash-sales-development-representative-japanese-speaking

jobs.title: Social Media Content Creator (UGC/Pizza industry)
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: http://www.fuseworldwide.net

Title: Social Media Content Creator (Pizza industry)
Location: Remote (candidates must be located in the United States)
Company: Fortune 100 Food & Beverage Manufacturing (FuseGlobal has worked with this company for 20 years)
Initial term: 12 months (position expected to run longer)
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 35 hours per week; Up to 25% travel (once per quarter)

Love Pizza? Love Creating Bold And Edgy UGC Food Content?

Let’s Cook.

About This Role:

We are searching for a motivated self-starter with a passion for producing engaging video and static content for social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram for two of our pizza brands. The ideal candidate is confident both on and behind the camera, savvy in graphic design for the digital space, and hyper-creative. They have a sharp eye for online trends, a genuine passion for the food industry, and are fired up about pioneering new creative tactics to drive engagement with Gen Z and millennial consumers. And, most importantly, they must love pizza!

We're looking for candidates who have experience with making food the star of the content through prep, food style, etc (bonus points for frozen food/pizza experience!). Ideally candidates are comfortable being both on camera talent when needed, but also experience making the food the central piece to the content in an edgy and bold style.

What You'll Do:

• Social Listening: Perform listening across channels to identify relevant trends and opportunities for content that allows the brands to drive engagement and relevancy.

• Develop and Pitch Creative Ideas: Generate and present innovative concepts for both static design and lo-fi lifestyle video content to be published on TikTok and Instagram that ladder back to brands’ strategy.

• End-to-End Content Creation: Design, produce, edit, and write post copy for all social content across TikTok and Instagram. Some content will be adapted for use in paid media campaigns, so an understanding of creative best practices for paid social is a plus.

• Perform On-Camera: Serve as on-camera talent as needed, bringing energy and engagement to each piece of content.

• Analyze and Optimize Performance: Track content performance metrics and share continuous optimization strategies to drive growth in engagements, reach, followers, etc.

• Trend-Savvy: Keep up to date with the latest trends and formats in short-form content to maintain relevance and audience appeal.

• Collaboration: Bring social-led ideas and continuously collaborate closely with the social media strategist and community manager on execution

What You Bring:

• Bachelor’s Degree preferred, not required.

• Minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in content creation and/or social media management representing a brand or organization.

• Strong content creation skills that are distinctive and reflect the brand’s strategy and voice.

• Demonstrated ability to think creatively and have a strong understanding of culture.

• Proficiency with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva Pro, InShot, CapCut, social media platforms – Instagram, TikTok and video editing knowledge required.

• Exceptional understanding of the social media landscape, including Instagram and TikTok.

• Ability to synthesize data to identify insights to inform creative content and opportunities.

• Exceptional communication (written and oral) skills.

• Experience successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously, self-direction, and collaborating successfully with multiple stakeholders and teams.

• A passion for food, and comfortable preparing frozen foods into content-ready meals.

Bonus Points:

• Experience using social listening and publishing tools.

• Previous experience working with large brands and partner agencies.

• Familiarity with paid social media content formats and performance metrics.

• Experience with food styling a plus.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Up to $41.00 per hour + Overtime

• Medical insurance

• Dental insurance

• Vision insurance

• 401(k)

• Disability insurance

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.

jobs.title: Video Editor - TTMK (Eaze)
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Karnataka, India

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app

Role - Video Editor
Work Location - Work From Home
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
About the role :
We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact.
Key Responsibilities:
● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.
● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts).
● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.
● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable.
● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates.
● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience.

What You’ll Bring
● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
● Any Bachelor’s degree.
● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).
● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.
● Language proficiency: Strong command over two languages minimum — English and TTMK— both written and spoken, to bring cultural nuance and flexibility in writing.
● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines
● Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks.

Why This Role Is Exciting :
● Create high-impact video content that drives engagement and brand growth.
● Collaborate with cross-functional creative and marketing teams.
● Shape storytelling across platforms with visible, meaningful impact.

Why Join Us:
● Create impactful video content
● Competitive pay and growth opportunities
● Work with a creative, fast-moving team We’ll Get Alo

Ellipsis is fast becoming the market leader in "GEO" for B2B technology companies. This is a senior, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The move to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative and strategic in our approach. We started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, so this has been a time for us to thrive.

We think we understand AI search better than almost anyone. We have our own tracking product, ~25 million AI answers to analyze (with more tracked every week), and execution end-to-end: strategy, writing, in-house design, optimization, and performance reporting.

You'll run the Strategy team, set the strategy for our biggest accounts yourself, and build a strategy service that holds its quality as we take on much larger projects.

Every client project should teach us more about what works, and that learning should make the next project faster and better. You’ll work closely with our Research and Development analyst to shape overall strategy, work with the team to ensure this is effectively used in practice, and ensure we have an effective feedback loop of findings <> implementation <> upskilling the team to ask better questions <> identifying gaps and new research.

jobs.title: Humbly Confident Marketing Lead
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Utah

URL: https://www.chirocat.com/

About Us and Why We're Hiring

We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients.

The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in!

We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us.

That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us.

What We're Looking For

REQUIREMENTS

For this role, you must:

•
Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan)

•
Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us

•
Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you

•
Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts

•
Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow)

•
Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence

•
Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving!

•
Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

These aren't required, but will help you stand out:

•
Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS

•
Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity

•
Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies

•
Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell.

•
Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom)

•
Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google)

•
Comfort making short-form video

•
Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.)

Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume.

Life at ChiroCat

ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do.

HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT

Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify.

Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone.

Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler

jobs.description:

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling
SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.
About the role
We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.
This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.
What you will do

• Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

• Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

• Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

• Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

• Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

• Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

• Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for

• Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

• A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

• Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

• AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

• Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

• Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

• Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure

• Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

• Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

• Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)

• Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

• Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

• Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

• Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

• Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding , closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times , The Wall Street Journal , Fortune , Forbes , CNBC , Bloomberg , and others.

Recognition

The role

Pacaso buyers are high-net-worth individuals making a considered purchase over months, sometimes years. They move between our site, email, messaging, and our Sales team, and today each of those runs on its own tools with its own picture of the customer. We believe one personalized system that follows each customer from first interest to purchase, and keeps serving them as an owner, will shorten the path to purchase and make our growth product-led.

We're hiring a principal-level technical product IC to architect that system and own its outcome. You'll define the reference architecture: how we recognize a customer across channels, what we know about them, how the system decides what to do next, and which of those decisions AI agents can make without a person. You'll prove the design with working prototypes you build yourself with AI tooling, then lead Engineering and Data in taking it to production.

This isn't a roadmap-and-backlog PM role, and it isn't a full-time production engineering role. It sits between them. You'll make product calls with Sales, Marketing, and leadership, make architecture calls with senior engineers, and be accountable for both.

Some of this is already moving. AI agents talk to our customers today, and parts of the data and decisioning exist. None of it runs end to end on its own yet. You'll take what's there, decide what to keep, and design the system that can.

What you'll own

• The architecture of the customer system. One design for new leads, dormant leads, and stalled buyers first, then owners who add a share, so the same person is served by one system instead of separate tools for each stage. You write the architecture and the decisions behind it, and other teams build against it.

• The customer intelligence layer. Identity across channels, the event and signal model, shared memory and context, scoring, eligibility and frequency caps, and the next-best-action logic that decides what happens next.

• Agent and workflow design. Which agents exist, what each one is allowed to decide, how they hand off to each other and to Sales, and the prompts, tools, and orchestration behind them.

• Trust and reliability. Evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, cost and latency budgets, and kill switches, in place before anything reaches a customer.

• The path to autonomy. What the system decides on its own, what still needs a person, and the evidence we need before we take that person out of the loop.

• Technical direction across teams. Build-versus-buy calls, data contracts with Engineering and Data, and integration standards for the CRM, messaging, email, and the site.

• The outcome. Funnel velocity (time from first interest to high intent, and to purchase) and the measured lift in qualified actions and closed sales.
